title: Hedera Pay
tagline: Hedera Pay - Hedera plugin for gasless, fee-free on-chain payments for apps and merchants
description:
HPay is a gasless payments plugin for the Hedera ecosystem that enables merchants, applications, and platforms to accept on-chain payments without requiring users to hold HBAR or pay network fees. Through sponsored transactions and the Hedera Token Service, HPay completely abstracts both user and merchant costs, delivering a fast, smooth, and familiar payment experience.
The plugin streamlines the integration of on-chain and commercial payments across e-commerce, point-of-sale systems, marketplaces, and mobile applications, allowing any business to accept tokens instantly with zero technical friction. With HPay, network fees disappear as a barrier to adoption, unlocking accessible, scalable, and production-ready blockchain payments.

Problem
Businesses that want to accept crypto payments face significant obstacles:
They must pay gas fees for each transaction.

They need to hold HBAR to operate.

Integrating on-chain payments involves technical complexity.

Variable costs make it difficult to predict expenses.

The experience does not feel as simple as Web2 (Stripe, PayPal, MercadoPago).

This creates friction and limits the adoption of decentralized payments in real businesses.

The Solution
Hedera Pay allows merchants to accept payments without worrying about gas.
Key features:
Gas-free payments 
 The buyer pays in tokens; the merchant does not incur fees.
Relayer or sponsor wallet
 All fees are covered by a sponsor defined by the merchant or the platform.
Simplified payment flows
Receive payments
Split payments
Create payment requests
Automate recurring payments

When you remove the fees… adoption finally becomes possible!
how_its_made:
Hedera Agent Kit Plugin
Native integration with the Hedera agent ecosystem.

Hedera Token Service
Ultra-fast transfers with minimal fees.

Sponsored Transactions
Allowance-based system for automatic transaction sponsorship.

Real-Time Metrics
Full analytics and management dashboard.Real Use Cases

E-commerce
Online stores accepting crypto payments with no complications and zero fees for customers.

Point of Sale
Physical merchants with instant checkout and a smooth in-store payment experience.

Marketplaces
Multi-vendor platforms with automatic split payments between sellers.

P2P Transfers
User-to-user payments without needing to hold funds for gas.

Ecosystem Impact:

For Merchants:
Drastic reduction in operational costs, simplified onboarding, and a frictionless UX for both employees and customers.

For Users:
Fast, secure, and transparent payments without complex fee calculations or technical concerns.

For Hedera:
Accelerates real-world commercial adoption, establishes standards for gasless commerce, and enables hybrid Web3–Web2 use cases.

The Future of Payments Is Gasless!
Hedera Pay removes the last barrier between blockchain and mass adoption in commerce. A payment experience as simple as Web2, with all the power of Web3.
